This patch adds checks for 'ioc->remove_host' in the SCSI error handlers
not to access pointers/resources potentially freed in the PCI shutdown/module
unload path.  The error handlers may be invoked after shutdown/unload
depending on other components.
This problem was observed with kexec on a system with a mpt3sas based adapter
and an infiniband adapter which takes long enough to shutdown:
The mpt3sas driver finished shutting down / disabled interrupt handling
some commands have not finished and timed out.
Since the system was still running (waiting for the infiniband adapter to
shutdown)
column2: the scsi error handler for task abort of mpt3sas was invoked

column1: hit an oops -- either in scsih_abort() because 'ioc->scsi_lookup' was NULL
without commit dbec4c9040ed (""scsi: mpt3sas: lockless command submission"")
later up in scsih_host_reset() (with or without that commit)
eventually called mpt3sas_base_get_iocstate().
After the above commit
column2: the oops in scsih_abort() does not occur anymore
